description: Wait for running sub-agents, wake on finish, and handle stop_agent across loop.coax, transcript.coax, host-api.coax, and agents-checks.coax.

steps.send: In `coax/lib/microcoder/loop.coax`, `apps/coder-desktop/page/transcript.coax`, `apps/coder-desktop/page/host-api.coax`, and `apps/coder-desktop/page/checks/agents-checks.coax` (#13766): handle `stop_agent` and wake the parent turn when a running sub-agent finishes. Verify with `coax/bin/coax test apps/coder-desktop/page.coax --only agent`.

graders.run: grep -q cp_agent_stopped_by_run apps/coder-desktop/page/host-api.coax && coax/bin/coax test apps/coder-desktop/page.coax --only agent
